title: Verify management, persistence, concurrency, and recovery
objective: Exercise /skills scopes, settings persistence, same-name ownership, concurrent refresh/toggle/invoke, resume, compact, and all user surfaces, including the single-line selected-detail and bounded-panel layout contract.
context: Complete one low-conflict slice of the accepted live skill catalog and cache-preserving design.
The worktree is shared and dirty; only owned_files may be modified.

source_evidence.note: Developer-context initial catalog and progressive disclosure inspiration.
Live discovery, visibility overrides, and skill lifecycle inspiration.

include: Test all four visibility states at session and persistent scopes.
Test managed read-only policy and reset-to-inherited.
Test concurrent refresh/toggle/snapshot/invoke under race detector.

Test exact /skills launcher routing versus /skills subcommand routing; exact /skills must immediately load the interactive checklist, while /skills list/show/set continue through the text command backend.
Test direct loading, left-side checkbox rendering, inert Enter, Backspace filter editing, and one-Esc close behavior without an intermediate action menu.

Test task_31 layout end to end: each list row occupies one terminal line with terminal-cell ellipsis, only the selected skill exposes details, and the complete bordered panel stays inside the viewport.
Test ASCII, CJK, combining text, emoji/ZWJ sequences, long names/summaries/paths/identity metadata, extreme narrow/short terminals, shrink/grow resize, filtering, and selected-row visibility.
Test Space with stable ID plus observed revision after filtering, after a concurrent refresh, and with same-name different-source rows.
Test that a configured-on shadowed row remains checked while selected details identify its winner, and that off/on plus winner removal keep configuration and activation semantics distinct.
Test persisted last non-off restoration after menu reopen, fresh store/process construction, and project-scoped text command transitions through off.
Test managed read-only and active-session-override conflicts without mutation.
Inject persistence failure, live-apply failure with successful rollback, and rollback failure; require authoritative redraw and a degraded-refresh-required warning for the last case.
Test TUI/screen-reader behavioral parity through shared contracts.
exclude: Do not collapse distinct failure modes into one broad smoke assertion.

implementation_steps: Build focused acceptance matrices in new files.
Report defects to task owners with exact scenario and expected state.
acceptance_criteria: Overrides persist only in requested scope.
Same-name skills never disable each other by accident.
Resume and compact respect context epoch visibility.
No data race appears across refresh/toggle/snapshot/invoke.
Exact /skills directly opens the authoritative checklist, while explicit /skills subcommands have distinct, verified text-command outcomes.

The direct checklist renders auto, name-only, and manual-only as [x] and off as [ ], changes only the selected stable ID when its observed revision is current, and immediately reflects the authoritative persisted effective state.

Every skill list row is a single physical terminal line and is ellipsized by display-cell width without splitting grapheme clusters or overflowing for CJK, combining text, emoji/ZWJ sequences, or long metadata.
Only the selected skill renders details; selection/filter changes remove old details, and every selected detail line remains within the inner panel width.
Across extreme height, width, and resize cases, the full skills panel including both borders remains inside the viewport and the selected row remains visible whenever a content row is available.
A shadowed non-off row stays checked but reports its winner stable ID as the reason it is currently inactive; winner removal clears that notice and makes the row active.
Stale revisions and active session overrides are rejected without mutation and tell the user how to refresh or clear the higher-priority scope.
Ordinary failures roll back both rendered and backend state; rollback failure is surfaced as degraded and redraws from a freshly read authoritative snapshot instead of claiming unchanged state.
dispatch_prompt: Add management/lifecycle/race acceptance tests only. Cover scopes, same-name identities, resume, compact, and surface parity; also exercise task 31 through render-level tests for one-row cell-width ellipsis, selected-only details, complete border containment, extreme width/height, resize, CJK, combining text, emoji/ZWJ, and long metadata. Do not edit production code.
notes_for_assignee: If verification exposes a defect in another owner's production file, report the exact failing test and owner task; do not patch across ownership boundaries.
